description: HTTP client for Node.js and Bun with a Chrome TLS (JA3/JA4), HTTP/2 (Akamai) and header-order fingerprint. Rust + BoringSSL engine, proxies, cookies, streaming, custom fingerprint profiles.
rules: Import named exports: import { createClient } from 'omreq'. There is no default export and no top-level get or fetch function.
Create one client per configuration (profile, proxy, baseUrl) and reuse it; it owns the connection pool, TLS session cache and cookie jar.
HTTP 4xx and 5xx responses do not throw; check res.ok or res.status. Network, TLS, timeout and limit failures reject with OmreqError.
Read every response body with text(), json(), bytes() or the body stream, or call res.dispose(); await using disposes automatically.
The form and searchParams options take [name, value] pairs or URLSearchParams, not plain objects.
Close clients with await client.close() or declare them with await using.
